Studio work

Two Views

Year
2016
Material
Two-channel video installation, 10 min. loop. For back-to-back televisions or dual projection

Created by facing two cameras at each other with 1920 km between them, bridging the shortest distance between the artist’s country of birth and country of residence. Left camera: southernmost point of the USA, Key West, FL (24.545570, -81.783306), heading 137.4° SE, downward pitch 8.8°. Right camera: northernmost point of Curaçao, Watamula (12.390646, -69.156179), heading 317.4° NW, downward pitch 8.8°. Exhibited as back-to-back projections. Continuous loop. Silent.
